purpose: Calendar 日历: the reference 4.0.0 standalone month panel (added in 2.3.0) with event bars and drag-to-create; reference Gallery contract with the registered accessibility color differences (docs/DESIGN.md#measured-color-differences).

interface.inputs: Signature authority (all public constructors, parameters, types, requiredness and defaults): [IslandCalendar](../../lib/src/components/calendar.dart), [IslandCalendarEvent](../../lib/src/components/calendar.dart), [IslandCalendarColor](../../lib/src/components/calendar.dart). Only declarations exported by lib/animal_island_ui.dart are public. This contract defines behavior; it does not maintain a second parameter list.
interface.outputs: Selection requests (onChanged, a local-midnight day), panel month requests (onMonthChanged, the first day of the month) and drag-to-create requests (onCreateEvent, an ordered DateTimeRange whose start is the first and end the last day, inclusive, both at local midnight). The host decides whether to commit controlled values and whether to add an event.
interface.state_model: An always-visible month panel: no popup, no week or year view. The selected day and the panel month are independently controlled (value / month non-null) or component-owned (IslandCalendar.uncontrolled initialValue defaulting to today; initialMonth). The panel opens on initialMonth, else the selected day, else today. The grid always holds 42 days from the Sunday on or before the 1st. A keyboard cursor (roving focus) is clamped into the visible grid on every build, and the shown selection is clamped by the same rule, so exactly one cell is a Tab stop and the cursor and selection share a cell. Event layout is recomputed from the events list on every build. Event start and end days are read from each DateTime's own calendar fields, as DatePicker reads its values: a UTC value lands on its UTC date and shows its UTC HH:mm; the end's time of day is ignored.
interface.events: Activating a cell or the today action (今天) selects that day; a day outside the panel month also requests that month. Event bars are transparent to pointers (reference .eventsLayer pointer-events: none): a click, the hover tint and the drag cursor over a bar belong to the day cell under it. Month/year arrows request the adjacent month/year and move the cursor to the same day clamped to the target month length; they do not select. A drag reports one ordered range on release.
interface.composition: Parent owns placement; the panel is `width` wide (reference `width` prop, clamped to the parent's maximum width) or, when width is null, fills the available width (750 when unbounded), and derives its rhythm from that width: scale = width / 750 clamped to 0.6..2 multiplies the week-header height 32, cell height 104, day circle 28, number band 42, event row 22, bar height 17 and event font 11; the day number stays 13px. The header (year/month arrows, month chip, 今天, month/year arrows) keeps reference space-between, is as tall as the month chip (padding 4 around 15px text at the reference line-height: normal (Blink rounding: the fonts' ascent and descent each rounded to whole pixels, so a zh chip with a CJK fallback run is 22 + 8 = 30px), 1.448 em: 29.7px) and, when the space-between row overflows, shrinks the month chip and the 今天 group in proportion to their max-content widths down to their min-content widths (CSS flex-shrink; break opportunities beside every CJK ideograph, as Blink), wrapping their text with one Blink line box per line (2026 / 年8月 at 375: a 50px chip in one toolbar row); it wraps its three groups only below their summed min-content widths (narrow-layout usability difference, docs/DESIGN.md#gallery-parent-layout).
interface.accessibility: Arrow controls are named by IslandLocalizations previousYear / previousMonth / nextMonth / nextYear (zh 上一年 / 上个月 / 下个月 / 下一年); the today action is named by its visible text. Each day cell is a selectable action named by IslandLocalizations.calendarDay: zh 'YYYY-MM-DD', or 'YYYY-MM-DD {n} 项事项：{titles joined by ，}' where n counts the visible events covering that day, duplicate titles collapse with a trailing ' 等' and empty titles are omitted ('YYYY-MM-DD {n} 项事项' when none remain); en 'YYYY-MM-DD, {n} event(s): {titles joined by ", "}' with ' and more'. Event bars, day digits and +N are excluded from semantics. semanticLabel names the grid. Arrow keys move the cursor by a day/week and move focus with it, requesting an adjacent month only when the cursor leaves the panel month; PageUp/PageDown change month; Enter/Space select the focused cell exactly once. Screen-reader execution is excluded by the 2026-10-17 user scope decision.
interface.localization: All chrome comes from IslandLocalizations; zh output equals the reference: today (今天 / Today), the four arrow names, weekdaysFromSunday (日 一 二 三 四 五 六 / Sun..Sat), monthTitle ('YYYY年M月' / 'August 2026') and calendarDay cell names. Without an IslandLocalizations delegate the library default (English) applies. Event titles are caller text.
interface.lifecycle: The component owns and disposes its 42 cell focus nodes; a pending keyboard focus move is dropped after disposal. An active drag is discarded by a pointer cancel or a release outside the panel. Deliberate difference: the reference root onPointerCancel calls finishDrag and commits; Flutter delivers PointerCancelEvent when the system aborts the gesture (pointer lost, window or platform takeover) and its gesture recognizers report that as a cancel, never as completion, so the calendar does not create an event the user never released.
interface.styling: One foundation-owned recipe (lib/src/foundation/recipes/calendar.dart) holds the reference 4.0.0 calendar.module.less values: cream #fffdf7 card with the two-layer dot grid, 1.5px #e8dcc8 border, radius 20, 0 6 18 shadow; teal accent #19c8b9 with its 14% soft and #e6f9f6 tint; five event palettes (teal is the warm orange set). Cells: radius 12, hover #f4f0e4, selected tint with a filled accent circle and onLeaf digit, today an inset 1.5px link ring and link digit, neighbouring-month digits in muted ink; precedence selected > hover > today / outside (reference `.cell:hover .dayNumber` outranks the today and outside digit rules: a hovered today or neighbouring-month digit is #5a4530 / 700 and the today ring stays). Event bars: 1px border, radius 10 (6 for multi-day), 5px gutter; multi-day bars keep a 1px seam except at the week edges; the drag preview has a dashed border. Reference values that fail the text 4.5:1 / graphics 3:1 budget use the DatePicker roles or a same-hue deepened value, registered in docs/DESIGN.md#measured-color-differences. Reference 0.15s cell, digit, arrow and 今天 transitions; reduced motion settles them immediately.
interface.performance: Layout is O(events x weeks) per build. Platform profiling required before release.
interface.migration: New component; no previous Flutter API.

scenarios.given: The pinned reference 4.0.0 Calendar page and its three demos
scenarios.when: Capture the same viewport and interaction state
scenarios.then: Layout, typography, geometry and interaction agree; necessary accessibility color differences are registered against actual states/backgrounds under docs/DESIGN.md, and other differences remain failures.

scenarios.given: Any panel month, including one whose 1st is a Sunday, and any width
scenarios.then: 42 day cells in 6 weeks from the Sunday on or before the 1st, the 日..六 header and 'YYYY年M月'; the scale is width / 750 clamped to 0.6..2 and an event bar's vertical centre is (32 + week x 104 + 42 + (row + 1) x 22) x scale below the grid top, so two event rows end inside the week.

scenarios.given: Controlled and uncontrolled value and month, including a controlled value or unacknowledged month request outside the grid
scenarios.when: Click a cell, a neighbouring-month cell or 今天, or the parent changes value
scenarios.then: onChanged reports the day; an uncontrolled value and month follow it; a controlled month only receives onMonthChanged; a changed controlled value moves the cursor and an uncontrolled month to it; a value outside the grid shows selection and the single Tab stop on the nearest grid cell.

scenarios.given: Month/year arrows and keyboard focus inside the grid
scenarios.when: Press arrows, PageUp/PageDown, Enter or Space
scenarios.then: Uncontrolled months change themselves; controlled months request the change; moving inside the panel month requests nothing; crossing out requests the new month; focus follows the cursor; Enter/Space select once per key press; exactly one cell is focusable even when the month request is ignored.

scenarios.given: Same-day, multi-day, overlapping, timed and out-of-view events
scenarios.then: Events are placed in start-time order (stable for equal starts) into the first of 2 free rows per week; multi-day bars are cut at week boundaries; the first segment of an event starting in view shows 'HH:mm' when showEventTime and the event's showTime are set, continuation and truncated segments show the title only; a segment without a free row folds into '+N' (covering events minus drawn bars); events entirely outside the 42 cells are neither drawn, counted nor named; an end before the start is a one-day event; bars keep their identity by event id when events are inserted before them.

scenarios.given: onCreateEvent set, a primary mouse button and a pointer path across cells and event bars
scenarios.when: Press on a cell, move across cells or outside the grid, then release
scenarios.then: A dashed preview bar takes a row like an event but never counts toward '+N'; release anywhere inside the panel, header included, reports the ordered range once; a same-day press-release only selects; a release outside the panel or a pointer cancel discards it (deliberate difference from the reference, which commits on pointercancel); a secondary button or a missing onCreateEvent never starts a drag.
Cell, digit, arrow and 今天 colors settle immediately with the same states.
